Package com.tonic.analysis.pdg.slice

Class SliceResult

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.pdg.slice.SliceResult
  • public class SliceResult
extends Object
    The nodes and edges reached by a program slice, together with the criterion it was taken from.
